method: For each of six 512x512 row-major cells, isolate the largest alpha>=64 connected athlete component, retain only original alpha pixels within a 2px dilation, clear alpha below8, uniformly resize by nearest-neighbor to at most330x330, and center on zero-alpha canvas. No pose pixels redrawn, synthesized, copied, mirrored, or rearranged.
review: Independent reviewer passes source cleanup, transparent background, anatomy, cell margins and pose sequence.
